description: This source file defines a serializer for the System.Exception type and its derivatives, including specific handling for AggregateException. It implements serialization, deserialization, copying, and type support logic, and includes auxiliary surrogate serialization for AggregateException. The class ExceptionCodec is referenced for focused exception serialization within the Orleans.Serialization namespace.
external_methods: Serializer related methods for ConvertFromSurrogate and ConvertToSurrogate
